                        if (now - event_time).total_seconds() <= self.failed_login_window:

        for ip, failures in recent_failures.items():
            if len(failures) >= self.failed_login_threshold:

            if event.event_type == SecurityEventType.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.value:
                self._trigger_alert(event, "Privilege escalation detected")

    def _check_data_exfiltration(self, events: List[SecurityEvent]) -> None:
        file_accesses = defaultdict(int)
        for event in events:
            if event.event_type == SecurityEventType.FILE_ACCESS.value and event.user_id:
                file_accesses[event.user_id] += 1

        for user, count in file_accesses.items():
            if count > 100:  # Threshold for suspicious file access
                last_event = [e for e in events if e.user_id == user and e.event_type == SecurityEventType.FILE_ACCESS.value][-1]
                self._trigger_alert(last_event, f"Potential data exfiltration: User {user} accessed {count} files")

    def _monitor_loop(self) -> None:
        while self.running:
            events = self.logger.get_events(limit=1000)
            self._check_failed_logins(events)
            self._check_privilege_escalation(events)
            self._check_data_exfiltration(events)
            time.sleep(self.check_interval)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if not self.running:
            self.running = True
            self.monitor_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._monitor_loop, daemon=True)
            self.monitor_thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self.running = False
        if self.monitor_thread:
            self.monitor_thread.join(timeout=5)

    def get_statistics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        events = self.logger.get_events()
        stats = {
            "total_events": len(events),
            "by_type": defaultdict(int),
            "by_severity": defaultdict(int),
            "unique_users": set(),
            "unique_ips": set()
        }

        for event in events:
            stats["by_type"][event.event_type] += 1
            stats["by_severity"][event.severity] += 1
            if event.user_id:
                stats["unique_users"].add(event.user_id)
            if event.source_ip:
                stats["unique_ips"].add(event.source_ip)

        stats["unique_users"] = len(stats["unique_users"])
        stats["unique_ips"] = len(stats["unique_ips"])
        stats["by_type"] = dict(stats["by_type"])
        stats["by_severity"] = dict(stats["by_severity"])

                    try:
                        event_time = datetime.fromisoformat(event.timestamp)
                        if (now - event_time).total_seconds() <= self.failed_login_window:
                            recent_failures[event.source_ip].append(event)
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

        for ip, failures in recent_failures.items():
            if len(failures) >= self.failed_login_threshold:
                self._trigger_alert(failures[-1], f"Brute force detected from IP {ip}: {len(failures)} failed attempts")

    def _check_privilege_escalation(self, events: List[SecurityEvent]) -> None:
        for event in events:
            if event.event_type == SecurityEventType.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.value:
                self._trigger_alert(event, "Privilege escalation detected")

    def _check_data_exfiltration(self, events: List[SecurityEvent]) -> None:
        file_accesses = defaultdict(int)
        for event in events:
            if event.event_type == SecurityEventType.FILE_ACCESS.value and event.user_id:
                file_accesses[event.user_id] += 1

        for user, count in file_accesses.items():
            if count > 100:  # Threshold for suspicious file access
                last_event = [e for e in events if e.user_id == user and e.event_type == SecurityEventType.FILE_ACCESS.value][-1]
                self._trigger_alert(last_event, f"Potential data exfiltration: User {user} accessed {count} files")

    def _monitor_loop(self) -> None:
        while self.running:
            events = self.logger.get_events(limit=1000)
            self._check_failed_logins(events)
            self._check_privilege_escalation(events)
            self._check_data_exfiltration(events)
            time.sleep(self.check_interval)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if not self.running:
            self.running = True
            self.monitor_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._monitor_loop, daemon=True)
            self.monitor_thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self.running = False
        if self.monitor_thread:
            self.monitor_thread.join(timeout=5)

    def get_statistics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        events = self.logger.get_events()
        stats = {
            "total_events": len(events),
            "by_type": defaultdict(int),
            "by_severity": defaultdict(int),
            "unique_users": set(),
            "unique_ips": set()
        }

        for event in events:
            stats["by_type"][event.event_type] += 1
            stats["by_severity"][event.severity] += 1
            if event.user_id:
                stats["unique_users"].add(event.user_id)
            if event.source_ip:
                stats["unique_ips"].add(event.source_ip)

        stats["unique_users"] = len(stats["unique_users"])
        stats["unique_ips"] = len(stats["unique_ips"])
        stats["by_type"] = dict(stats["by_type"])
        stats["by_severity"] = dict(stats["by_severity"])

        return stats

def create_security_system(log_file: str = "security.log") -> tuple:
    logger = SecurityLogger(log_file=log_file)
    monitor = SecurityMonitor(logger)

    def default_alert_handler(event: SecurityEvent) -> None:
        print(f"[SECURITY ALERT] {event.timestamp} - {event.description}")

    monitor.add_alert_callback(default_alert_handler)
    return logger, monitor

def simulate_security_events(logger: SecurityLogger, count: int = 10) -> List[SecurityEvent]:

    events = []
    users = ["admin", "user1", "user2", "guest"]

            source_ip=ip,
            user_id=user,
            resource=f"/resource/{i}",
            metadata={"simulation": True, "index": i}
        )
        events.append(event)
        time.sleep(0.01)

    return events

if __name__ == "__main__":
